title: NeurIPS 2025
description: NeurIPS 2025 ran December 1-7 in Vancouver and online, the flagship academic conference for machine learning research with main-track papers, datasets and benchmarks track, and creative AI special sessions.

title: CES 2026
description: CES 2026 ran January 6-9 in Las Vegas, with AI agent product launches, AI PCs, and on-device AI from NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, Qualcomm, Samsung, and consumer hardware partners as central themes.

title: AI Engineer Summit NYC 2026
description: AI Engineer Summit NYC 2026 brought together AI engineers, infrastructure builders, and applied researchers for two days of talks on RAG, agents, evals, and production patterns.

title: Anthropic Partner Summit 2026
description: Anthropic hosted its inaugural Partner Summit in Carlsbad for strategic partners, with executive strategy, product deep dives, hands-on collaboration, and a livestream.

title: NVIDIA GTC 2026 keynote and AI conference
description: NVIDIA GTC 2026 ran March 16-19 in San Jose and online, centered on AI infrastructure, AI factories, agentic systems, physical AI, CUDA, and accelerated computing.

title: Mistral AI at NVIDIA GTC 2026
description: Mistral AI joined NVIDIA GTC with open-model, inference, customization, and deployment discussions for builders optimizing language model systems.

title: ICLR 2026
description: ICLR 2026 ran April 13-16 in Vienna, the flagship academic conference for representation learning research with workshops on alignment, agents, and large multimodal models.

title: Meta LlamaCon 2026
description: Meta hosted LlamaCon 2026 with announcements across the Llama 4 ecosystem, the Llama Stack 1.0 release, and partner deployments on AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure.

title: Google Cloud Next 26
description: Google Cloud Next 26 showcased Google Cloud AI announcements including Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, agentic data cloud updates, and next-generation TPU infrastructure.

title: Databricks Data + AI Summit CFP closes
description: Databricks closed the call for proposals for Data + AI Summit 2026 (June 22-25 in San Francisco), with featured tracks on AI agents, data warehousing, and Mosaic AI.

title: RSA Conference 2026
description: RSA Conference 2026 ran May 4-7 in San Francisco with AI security, agentic vulnerability research, and AI in the SOC as central themes for security practitioners and CISOs.

title: GPT-5.5 on 5/5 community event
description: A GPT-5.5 themed community event and OpenAI/Codex-adjacent gathering landed on 5/5 at 5:55pm PT, following GPT-5.5 availability in ChatGPT and Codex.

title: Code with Claude San Francisco

title: Code with Claude Extended San Francisco

title: Code with Claude London
description: Anthropic brings Code with Claude to London with workshops, live demos, and livestream access for Claude developers.

title: Google I/O 2026 day 1
description: Google I/O 2026 opens online May 19 with Google and developer keynotes, expected to center on Gemini, Android, web, and Google developer platforms.

title: Code with Claude Extended London
description: Anthropic follows Code with Claude London with an Extended builder-focused event for independent developers and founders.

title: Google I/O 2026 day 2
description: Second day of Google I/O 2026 sessions and developer content for Gemini, Android, web, cloud, and AI builders.

title: Mistral AI Now Summit
description: Mistral AI hosts AI Now Summit in Paris with keynotes, workshops, and tracks for leaders and builders moving AI from POC to production.

title: Microsoft Build 2026
description: Microsoft Build 2026 runs June 2-3 in San Francisco and online, with AI, Azure, GitHub, OpenAI, developer tooling, and production app patterns as core themes.

title: Apple WWDC26
description: Apple WWDC26 runs June 8-12 online and free, revealing the latest Apple tools, frameworks, features, and developer sessions across Apple platforms and machine learning technologies.

title: Code with Claude Tokyo
description: Anthropic brings Code with Claude to Tokyo with workshops, live demos, and livestream access for Claude developers.

title: Code with Claude Extended Tokyo
description: Anthropic follows Code with Claude Tokyo with an Extended builder-focused event for independent developers and founders.

title: Databricks Data + AI Summit 2026
description: Databricks Data + AI Summit 2026 ran June 22-25 in San Francisco with keynotes on Mosaic AI, AI agents on the lakehouse, and the Genie Spaces conversational analytics surface.

title: Snowflake Summit 2026
description: Snowflake Summit 2026 ran June 8-11 in Las Vegas with announcements across Cortex AI, Snowflake Intelligence agents, and Iceberg tables.

title: CVPR 2026
description: CVPR 2026 ran June 22-26 in Seattle, the flagship academic conference for computer vision and pattern recognition with workshops on multimodal foundation models and embodied agents.

title: ICML 2026
description: ICML 2026 ran July 13-19 in Stockholm and online, the flagship academic conference for machine learning research with featured tracks on alignment, foundation models, and reinforcement learning.

title: AI Engineer World's Fair 2026
description: AI Engineer World's Fair 2026 returned to San Francisco for three days of tracks on agents, evals, RAG, code, security, and infrastructure with hands-on labs and live demos.

title: DEF CON 34 AI Village
description: The AI Village at DEF CON 34 returned with the third public Generative Red Team challenge, hands-on adversarial AI workshops, and a Cyber Resilience track aligned with frontier-model labs.

title: OpenAI DevDay 2026
description: OpenAI DevDay 2026 is OpenAI’s biggest event of the year, scheduled for September 29 in San Francisco.

title: OpenAI Research Day
description: OpenAI Research Day showcased frontier safety, alignment, capabilities research, and research-team hiring, with livestreamed sessions for the academic and partner community.

title: Microsoft Ignite 2026
description: Microsoft Ignite 2026 ran October 20-23 in Chicago and online, Microsoft's flagship IT-pro and developer event for Azure AI, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Fabric, and security.

title: AWS re:Invent 2026 opens
description: AWS re:Invent 2026 runs November 30-December 4 in Las Vegas, AWS’s flagship cloud event for builders, cloud pioneers, and generative AI teams.

title: NeurIPS 2026
description: NeurIPS 2026 runs December 7-13 in San Diego and online, the flagship academic conference for machine learning research with main-track papers, datasets and benchmarks track, and creative AI special sessions.
